0022600093.text: Both teams open their 2026-27 seasons, with the Clippers hosting the Kings. The Clippers are missing Bradley Beal (knee inflammation), Jordan Miller (shoulder surgery), Max Strus (foot), and Yanic Konan Niederhauser (foot surgery), while the Kings are without Ben Simmons (ruptured Achilles), Dylan Cardwell (calf strain), Malik Monk (ankle soreness), and Maxime Raynaud (dislocated knee). The Clippers won the 2025-26 season series 3-1, including a 138-109 win in Sacramento on April 5, 2026, their most recent meeting.
